title: Duplicate the Elements of a List
required_features: First-order recursive logical measures returning an algebraic List value
Structural recursion synthesis with no trusted algorithmic components

Emit exactly two adjacent copies for each input occurrence, including repeated equal values.
Remain polymorphic and do not compare, inspect, mutate, or otherwise constrain elements.
